description: This is a startup script for initializing and managing a MySQL database server, including checks for existing instances, starting the server, configuring the database, applying schema and seed data, and saving connection info.

methods.name: ping_mysql
methods.description: Checks if MySQL server is already running via mysqladmin ping.

methods.name: verify_database_accessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the database exists and is accessible with current credentials.

methods.name: check_process_on_port
methods.description: Checks if a MySQL process is running on the specified port.

methods.name: initialize_mysql_data_directory
methods.description: Initializes MySQL data directory if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: start_mysql_server
methods.description: Starts the MySQL server with given configuration.

methods.name: wait_for_mysql_ready
methods.description: Polls until MySQL responds to ping, indicating it is ready.

methods.name: configure_mysql
methods.description: Sets root authentication, creates database and users, grants privileges.

methods.name: apply_schema_and_seed
methods.description: Applies SQL schema and seed files if present.

methods.name: save_connection_info
methods.description: Saves connection command and environment variables to files.
